cell.label: Pheochromocytoma suspected. Order plasma-free metanephrines and 24-hour urine for catecholamines and metanephrines.
cell.path: High (>2 times the upper limit of normal)

cell.label: Evaluate for differential diagnosis of spells.
Pheochromocytoma confirmed. Consider genetic testing; preoperative preparation with (alpha/calcium channel blockers).
Reassess the diagnosis Consider functional imaging: 123 I-MIBG scan episode.
Consider unusual type of pheo or malignant pheo.
PET Scan or PET with FDG if needed.
Consider venous sampling coupled with measurement of plasma-free metanephrines.
May stop work-up here if pretest probability was low; otherwise evaluate as for mild elevation.

footnotes.footnote: Consider medications that interfere with catecholamine assays, and if feasible, stop such medications prior to testing.
Consider glucagon stimulation test, if index of suspicion is high.
If pretest index of suspicion is low, consider incidentaloma.
